clusters.name: generator-and-artifacts
clusters.executionModeRationale: Serial within the cluster because US-002 reads the changed generator and US-005 verifies the post-delete state. The cluster as a whole runs first because every other change depends on the generator's new output location.

clusters.name: manifest-and-versions
clusters.executionModeRationale: Serial because US-004 sets the version field in the manifest that US-003 creates. Could be a single story; split for clean commit boundaries.

clusters.name: docs-and-verification
clusters.executionModeRationale: US-006 doc updates land before US-007 verification. US-007 needs an actual Copilot install to validate the manifest shape and is the final gate.
